data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered HTTP 400 errors when attempting to audit .SRCINFO and .gitignore, resulting in an inconclusive overall verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO and .gitignore due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit tool should not mark the entire audit as inconclusive if it fails to review non-executable metadata files like .SRCINFO or .gitignore, provided the executable PKGBUILD is successfully audited and deemed safe.
Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for transient LLM API errors on low-risk files to prevent unnecessary escalations.
